rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act
rules.requirement: A landlord ending a tenancy or not renewing a lease must give the tenant a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources at the same time as the Notice to Quit, and send a copy of the notice with a Certificate of Compliance/Service to the City's Office of Housing Stability. Violations do not halt the eviction.
rules.key_value: Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources delivered with every notice to quit/non-renewal
rules.quoted_span: The Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources must be delivered at the same time as the Notice to Quit.
rules.effective_date_note: FAQ states HSNA becomes effective November 6, 2020; ordinance passed October 2020.
rules.exemptions: Residences in a hospital, skilled nursing facility or health facility; non-profit short-term substance abuse treatment facilities.
rules.penalty: 1st offense: warning; 2nd and subsequent: $300 per day (enforced by ISD).

unverifiable_exemptions: residence in hospital, skilled nursing or health facility
non-profit short-term substance abuse treatment facility
